import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_clean.unique()):
    mask = sleep_disorder_clean == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Sleep Duration'], 
               df.loc[mask, 'Quality of Sleep'],
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=80, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Sleep Duration'].dropna() for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
bmi_labels = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
bp = ax2.boxplot(bmi_data, labels=bmi_labels, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
plt.setp(ax2.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 3. Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], 
                     df['Stress Level'],
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     cmap='RdYlGn', 
                     s=60, 
                     alpha=0.6,
                     edgecolors='black',
                     linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity\n(colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation (top 10)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax4.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_sleep)])
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Top 10 Occupations by Average Sleep Duration', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax4.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. Correlation between Daily Steps and Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax5.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.5, s=50, color=colors[4])
z = np.polyfit(df['Daily Steps'].dropna(), df['Heart Rate'].dropna(), 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax5.plot(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values(), p(df['Daily Steps'].sort_values()), 
         "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2, label=f'Trend line')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
disorder_gender = pd.crosstab(df['Gender'], sleep_disorder_clean, normalize='index') * 100
disorder_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, stacked=False, color=colors[:len(disorder_gender.columns)])
ax6.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax7.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color=colors[6], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
